However, since this hasn't properly landed in Flutter yet, report problems to me and not Flutter/CodeDoctorDE. - (For contributors) We're also experimenting with @cubic-dev-ai AI code reviews. Feedback welcome. Hopefully it's more helpful than not. - F-Droid now builds pdfium from source by @adil192 in https://gitlab.com/fdroid/fdroiddata/-/merge_requests/38937 - Fixed a collision between Android and Linux pdfium libs by @adil192 in https://github.com/espresso3389/pdfrx/pull/648 - Updated iOS/macOS builds to Xcode 26.3 - Several CI and developer experience improvements including better caching, faster tests, and better failure messages. * l10n(cs): Add fallback info to README by @ceskyDJ in https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/pull/1755 - Full changelog: https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/compare/v1.34.1...v1.34.2

[f-droid]: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.adilhanney.saber/ [flathub]: https://flathub.org/apps/details/com.adilhanney.saber [google_play]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adilhanney.saber [app_store]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/saber/id1671523739 [releases]: https://github.com/adil192/saber/releases # Changelog - Added Polish and Catalan translations - Added a confirmation prompt when deleting notes by @ZebraVogel94349 in https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/pull/1100 - Allowed undoing/redoing changing the background pattern - Fixed a bug where changing the background pattern didn't trigger an autosave by @ecezyk in https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/pull/1723 - Misc: - Performance: Switched to using BorderRadius' const constructor, mirroring a Flutter PR https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/183074 - CI: Proper formatting is now enforced on the `packages` dir - Distribution: Flathub now links directly to Weblate instead of the wiki's translate page - i18n: Auto translations are now done by a local LLM (Gemma 4) instead of Google Translate for improved quality. The speed and reliability of the scripts are also greatly improved. (Note: These auto translations are only used in the interim before real human translations are contributed, since half-assed translations are better than falling back to English.) - Logging: Added some missing stacktraces when reporting error logs. - Performance: Continued work towards migrating to `flutter_hooks` for state management. In time, this will bring better performance, improved reliability, and reduced boilerplate. - Fix: In v1.33.0, I accidentally set the canvas HUD's initial opacity to 1. This has been restored to 0. - Translations - i18n: Update Italian by @albanobattistella in https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/pull/1724 - i18n: add Vietnamese README and description by @an2in in https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/pull/1697 - i18n: Update Catalan by @Mel-l-l in 1ad52043b0dd9e7b62b394ba4518991e0966abc1 - i18n: Update Spanish by @Mel-l-l in ea9bdcc51148b14ac81115f5ebc907d3da705a18 - i18n: Add Catalan by @Mel-l-l in 1f818fb372ac652cc4290d71a240e09024c213a7 - i18n: Update Polish by @thesonofanxiety in cf5711e03f3ed0ad3916ca5a4e4a8ebdaa06778d - i18n: Add Polish by @thesonofanxiety in e19c32656012af21728344eb33a30147bd3dc13d - i18n: Update Hebrew by @omeritzics in ac444771d1f69137897f329082f8131fb9672f8c - @ecezyk made their first contribution in https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/pull/1723 - Full changelog: https://github.com/saber-notes/saber/compare/v1.33.0...v1.33.1
